control_groups.rule: mean of the same (plate, cell_line) group's QC-pass control rows on the log layer (tahoe_control_groups.parquet + tahoe_pairs.npz); never across cell lines

gene_axis.measurement_mask: var.gene_measured is PER SOURCE: all True in cm_transfer.h5ad; False only for FAM153B in tahoe_transfer.h5ad.  It is gene-space membership, never a non-zero-count test (18 all-zero Tahoe columns are measured).

notes: formal runs use the frozen locked recipe and no budget override
locked config notes: mapping=['metric.selection_metric -> metric.metric_name'] defaulted=[]

selection.test_usage: the Tahoe test/valid split never informs LR, epoch, seed or capacity
selection.validation_split: frozen tahoe_split valid = plate13 + plate14 (matched (plate, cell_line) DMSO control mean, log1p)
